headline: NQ is −2.6% after Amazon's double miss and Intel's −25% guide, sitting on its overnight low and pointing to a cash open below last week's NDX lows. Small short while NQ stays under the overnight midpoint; the gap is already very large, and yields are falling.
session_note: Cash open 9:30 AM ET (10:30 AM Atlantic) · morning window · Barkin 9:30 · Chicago PMI 9:45 AM ET · month-end

flip.long: NQ reclaims the overnight midpoint ~28,970 and then the overnight high 29,180.00 (≈ NDX 29,020), which would mean the gap is being bought. Stronger back above Thursday's NDX close 29,402 (≈ NQ 29,562 settle).
flip.short: Stays SHORT while NQ is below ~28,970. Adds conviction on a break of the overnight low 28,762.75 (≈ NDX 28,603, under the Sep 16 low 28,753), especially if the 10-year bounces back toward 5.00%.

thesis: There's a small short edge at the open, low conviction. The NDX fell 1.4% Thursday to 29,402.51 (range 29,257.05–29,517.80) on Alphabet's record selloff [1]. After the close, **Amazon reported a double miss on EPS and revenue, a second straight quarter of negative free cash flow and a soft holiday guide**, overshadowing AWS's fastest growth in five years; the stock is about −7% premarket [3,4,5]. **Intel is about −25%** after guiding below expectations and warning it will burn cash this year, and chips are lower with it (AMD about −9%, Nvidia −3%) [3,4]. **NQ is −759 pts / −2.57% at 28,803.00 (8:36 AM ET)**, pinned near the bottom of a 28,762.75–29,180.00 overnight range; the selling grew through the night (−2.16% at 4:04 AM, −2.41% at 7:14 AM) [2,3,6]. With a ~160-pt futures premium, that implies a cash open near ~28,640, **below the Oct 22–23 lows (28,855 / 28,826) and the Sep 16 low 28,753**, the lowest since early August [1,2]. This is a tech-only selloff: Dow futures are flat to green and ES is only −1.0% [3,9]. Macro is the one cushion: the 10-year is down ~6 bp to ~4.93%, the dollar is −0.3% at ~101.7, and the 8:30 Employment Cost Index was in line at 0.8% q/q (wages slowed to 0.7%) [7,9]. December hike odds have eased to ~73–80% (from ~81% Thursday) [8]. Oil is up ~2% (WTI ~$103.9) and VIX is +8% at ~18.6 [9]. So the call is **a small SHORT while NQ stays under its overnight midpoint**, but at −2.6% into month-end the gap can snap back hard, so keep size small.

bullets.label: The gap is down and through last week's lows.
bullets.text: NQ is −2.57% at 28,803.00 near the bottom of its 28,762.75–29,180.00 overnight range [2]. On a ~160-pt premium, that implies a cash open around ~28,640, below Thursday's 29,257 low, the Oct 22–23 lows and the Sep 16 low, the lowest since early August [1,2]. That's an estimate, not a quote.

bullets.label: Two more megacap catalysts, and it's spreading.
bullets.text: Amazon missed on EPS and revenue with negative free cash flow again and a soft holiday guide (≈ −7%); Intel guided below and warned of cash burn (≈ −25%) [3,4,5]. Chips are lower with it (AMD −8.7%, Nvidia −3%), and the Nasdaq-100 is on track to lose ~$950B in value today [3]. Dow futures are flat to higher, so it's a tech-specific move again [3,9].

bullets.label: Momentum is with the sellers.
bullets.text: The loss grew all night: −2.16% at 4:04 AM, −2.41% at 7:14 AM, −2.57% at 8:36 AM, and NQ is within ~40 pts of its overnight low [2,3,6]. VIX is +8% at ~18.6 and the Binance $6.3B hack is weighing on crypto-linked names [4,9].

bullets.label: The morning is the clean window.
bullets.text: Still to come: Barkin (radio, 9:30 AM ET), Chicago PMI 9:45 AM ET (est. ~56.1, prior 58.8), Daly at noon and Musalem at 12:30 PM [10]. No UMich release today (next is Nov 6). It's also month-end and the last session before Tuesday's midterms [4,10].

bullets.label: Bull case:
bullets.text: A −2.6% gap is already large, and yields are giving real relief: the 10-year is −6 bp at ~4.93%, the dollar is lower, ECI was in line and December hike odds have slipped [7,8,9]. Alphabet is stabilizing after its record drop, AWS growth was the fastest in five years, and month-end rebalancing plus dip-buyers (Raymond James' Orton is calling it a buying opportunity) could drive a sharp gap fill toward the overnight high [3,4].

bullets.label: Bear case:
bullets.text: This is the third straight day of megacap AI-spending punishment (Alphabet, then Amazon, Intel) with negative free cash flow as the common thread, and the NDX is on course to break a two-month winning streak [3,4]. A breakdown below last week's lows opens the early-August area, and a bounce in yields toward 5% would remove the one cushion [1,9].

bullets.label: Stay/scale SHORT:
bullets.text: NQ stays below the overnight midpoint ~28,970 and cash NDX stays below the Oct 23 low 28,826 through the first 30 minutes. Add on a break of the NQ overnight low 28,762.75 (≈ NDX 28,603), ideally with AMZN and INTC making new lows and the 10-year bouncing.

bullets.label: Flip to LONG:
bullets.text: NQ reclaims the overnight high 29,180.00 (≈ NDX 29,020) and holds, meaning the gap is being bought. Stronger on a move back toward Thursday's settle 29,562.00.

bullets.label: Flip to STAND ASIDE:
bullets.text: If NQ reclaims ~28,970 but stalls under 29,180, or chops across the overnight low with no follow-through in the first 30 minutes, there's no edge. Cut size into the close either way: month-end flows and a weekend before the Nov 3 midterms.

bullets.label: Wildcards:
bullets.text: Chicago PMI at 9:45 AM ET and Barkin/Daly/Musalem on December-hike talk, oil (WTI +1.9%), further Binance-hack fallout, and midterm headlines [4,9,10].
